source: Open Power System Data (OPSD) time series, package 2020-10-06
solar_interpretation: Rooftop-PV generation is driven by universal solar-irradiance physics; the simulated PV daily shape matches real measured DE generation with r=0.954. This validates the PV model against real data.
load_interpretation: The DE transmission-aggregate load peaks in the morning (commercial/industrial-dominated), whereas the AMANAH feeder models a Tunisian residential low-voltage network that peaks in the evening (air-conditioning + domestic demand). The low/negative correlation is an INTENTIONAL, documented regime difference (target geography + load mix), not a modelling error. The universal solar physics is the quantitative cross-check against real data.
